en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hama, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,

‘I asked Al-Abd Al-Salih<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) about the woman dying and her child is in her belly. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Her belly would be split and her child would be extracted’.
en.sarwar: 1. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad from Sama‘ah from Muhammad ibn abu Hamzah from Ali ibn Yaqtin who has said the f oho wing: “
I once asked the virtuous servant of Allah about the case of a woman who dies with her child in her womb. He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘Her belly is opened to remove her child.’”
